content.title: Selfie Landmark Route | Turn, Drink Stop and Riverside Resumption
content.summary: An adult illustrator turns through a riverside city route, pauses for one drink and resumes toward a sunset clock tower. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult traveler, one handheld selfie distance and one route direction anchor every chapter. + A single visible turn reveals landmarks without replacing the traveler or resetting the route. + One declared occlusion carrier may bridge locations while all identity and prop anchors persist. + Exactly one drink stop contains a complete sip and a restrained visible response. + The subject resumes movement with the same cup and ends against a readable destination landmark.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow one original adult travel illustrator with long black hair, a white overshirt, silver watch and kraft drink cup in a close handheld selfie along a busy riverside city route. Use a passing dark taxi as one wipe into the river promenade, preserving her face, hair, overshirt, watch, cup and forward route. She lowers the same cup, resumes walking for three steps and looks back once as the sunset clock tower fills the final background.

A single visible turn reveals landmarks without replacing the traveler or resetting the route.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.

creative_dna.mechanism: 用同一成年旅者、手持自拍距离和步行方向串联街道、地标道路与河岸；一次转身负责揭示地点，一次饮品停点完成体验证明，随后人物恢复行走并以日落地标收束。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult traveler, one handheld selfie distance and one route direction anchor every chapter.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult traveler, one handheld selfie distance and one route direction anchor every chapter."

invariants.rule: A single visible turn reveals landmarks without replacing the traveler or resetting the route.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "A single visible turn reveals landmarks without replacing the traveler or resetting the route."

invariants.rule: One declared occlusion carrier may bridge locations while all identity and prop anchors persist.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "One declared occlusion carrier may bridge locations while all identity and prop anchors persist."

invariants.rule: Exactly one drink stop contains a complete sip and a restrained visible response.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Exactly one drink stop contains a complete sip and a restrained visible response."

invariants.rule: The subject resumes movement with the same cup and ends against a readable destination landmark.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The subject resumes movement with the same cup and ends against a readable destination landmark."
